executionGate: T03 and T04 must be accepted before release-gate behavior or packaging verification.

harnessBoundary.platform: recording FakePlatform for P01-P28; dedicated controlled test window and synthetic text only for authorized live samples
harnessBoundary.assertions: externally observable result, clipboard/focus/input call counts, active/pending jobs, stage timings, package resource/hash/protocol identity, and rollback/data compatibility
forbiddenDuringFixtureRuns: user clipboard content or personal data
typing into the user's current application
treating SendInput acknowledgement as proof text appeared

g0RuntimeGates.input: Synthetic T05 interaction requests after the helper is already available.
g0RuntimeGates.action: Instrument process creation and synchronous child-process APIs while exercising representative hotkey, selection, and action paths.
g0RuntimeGates.expected: No interactive path calls spawnSync or another blocking process-spawn API.
g0RuntimeGates.observation: Record the instrumented API call trace and correlate it with request IDs; startup/package setup is outside the interactive interval.

g0RuntimeGates.input: One already-running helper instance and repeated synthetic interaction requests.
g0RuntimeGates.action: Record helper process identity before and after each interaction and count helper launches during the interaction interval.
g0RuntimeGates.expected: Interaction handling reuses the existing helper; no new helper process is created per interaction.
g0RuntimeGates.observation: Record process IDs/creation identities and launch counts alongside request IDs; helper startup/shutdown lifecycle remains separately covered by package checks.

Image preparation is delayed. Run A presses Enter or V again while preparation completes before the original 500ms deadline; run B keeps the trigger key held through that deadline and releases it only afterward; run C is released at the cutoff but preparation completes after it.
cases.action: Finish preparation in separate runs before and after the original selection-relative 500ms deadline; record the terminal job result, helper budget, clipboard and input calls through the post-deadline state recheck.
assert: before the deadline, the panel remains visible while the trigger key is held and the final input gate rechecks it
in run B, if the trigger key is still held when the original absolute 500ms selection deadline expires, terminate the job as key_held with zero SendInput calls
releasing the trigger key after that terminal deadline result does not resume the job or submit input
in run C, a released cutoff followed by late preparation uses a zero-budget immediate helper key check and never restarts a 500ms wait
a key held or re-pressed at the zero-budget check blocks clipboard commit; a later re-press blocks input
the deadline stays anchored to selection and image preparation never resets it

measurements.normalScenarioRule: Each normal timing scenario reported under §8, including normalText and wakeToActionable, requires at least 100 unique successful run/request IDs. Failed, cancelled, and timed-out runs are reported separately. A PASS requires controlled-live evidence; fake-only timings cannot satisfy it. A normalText PASS also requires independent verification that synthetic text appeared in the controlled editor.
measurements.normalTextTarget: inputSubmitted p95 < 150ms for a small text selection, released modifiers, and a valid controlled target; separately verify synthetic text appeared in the controlled editor
measurements.wakeTarget: prewarmed hotkey-to-list_actionable p95 < 100ms including capture, show, and first frame
report: actual sample count derived from samples.length
at least 100 unique successful requestIds for each PASS metric
separate failureCount, cancellationCount, and timeoutCount reconciled against raw samples
controlled-live mode and evidence references for PASS
measurements.clockRule: Use each process's monotonic durations; do not subtract uncalibrated clocks across processes.

packageAndRollbackChecks: Packaged Windows x64 helper resource resolves to the expected path and matches recorded version, protocol, and SHA-256/signature metadata.
Run cold startup, tray availability, app restart, normal exit, and helper shutdown from the packaged artifact.
Confirm old JSON data remains readable and app data is not deleted on uninstall/rollback.
Disable autoPaste and verify copy remains available; rollback helper binary without changing persisted data format.
Build a local internal artifact only; do not publish or release it.
